name: comp-100
title: Hamburger Menu Button
description: An icon button holding a hamburger menu symbol. Clicking it swings the three bars into an X and back again, while announcing whether the menu is open.
use: A compact nav toggle is needed in a top bar where an icon button fits better than a text label.
avoid: It only flips its own icon; you must build and wire the menu panel it is meant to control.
a11y: aria-label and aria-expanded are set, but the morph ignores prefers-reduced-motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A square icon button with rounded corners and a thin light outline sits on a near-black stage. Three short white horizontal bars are centred inside, evenly spaced. The button keeps the same size while the icon inside changes.
behaves: At rest the button shows three stacked bars. A click rotates and slides them into an X over about a third of a second with a slight overshoot; a second click returns them to bars.
customise: No props are exposed; icon size, stroke and timing live in the file, so changing them means editing the source or the shared Button variant.
weight: light: One small SVG with three paths animated by CSS transitions.
